_comment: Drop this at .claude/settings.json in an onboarded repo. The safety-check.sh
hook reads .harness/config.json to decide what to block. `continueOnBlock: true`
(Claude Code 2.1.139+) makes block decisions feed back to the agent as a tool
result instead of hard-stopping the turn — the model sees the rejection message
and can adjust (e.g. ask the user for `.harness/.allow-once`) instead of dying.
On Claude Code < 2.1.139 the key is silently ignored; behavior degrades to hard-stop.
